summary: Steel tower listed in Parry Sound District, though a second Ontario index puts a Sand Lake tower in Algoma District. Thin sources; site today unknown.

notes_for_editor: The two sources disagree on district. Firelookout.ca (the source of the record's local_unit, Parry Sound District; coordinates 45.674068, -80.989397) puts this tower in Parry Sound District. The Canada Lookouts Ontario index lists a Sand Lake in Algoma District, a light steel tower with an octagon cab. These may be two towers with the same name, or one entry may be wrong. The story reports the conflict and does not choose; no correction is proposed. Wikipedia's list of the Parry Sound Forest Fire District's lookouts does not name Sand Lake either. No construction date, height, staffing or fate was found in two searches. The Ontario-wide paragraph is general context from source 3, not specific to this tower. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
